BUG
1. The second BOSS: Queen of Thorns, after the update, the two battle phases of this BOSS will be divided into two different enemies. In this way, the BUG that may be caused after the death of the first battle phase of the BOSS is fixed.

2. Survivor mode. Now every 500 experience points on the ground will be absorbed once.

4. "Fizi"'s Wind Chime Pattern will be accompanied by the attack effect of the current highest attribute blessing.
5. The character's ray detection is moved from the feet to the center of the character
6. The blessing statue selection interface displays the blessing information by default (this item will optimize the controller experience).

If you encounter a bug after the update, please contact us.

notes.title: Thank you all for your support and recent plans!
notes.notes:
(๑╹◡╹)ﾉ” Hello everyone

The game has been released today!
Thank you all for your support!

We have received feedback from everyone in the community.
Two of them are more important:

1. The game does not have a windowed mode
In the next update, a windowed mode will be added.

2. "Survivor Mode" is not automatic attack or automatic skill release
We have indeed received a lot of feedback from players, hoping to simplify this mode.
Although I like this mode very much, this mode was added shortly before the release, so there are still many areas for improvement compared to the game's level-breaking mode.
We plan to start considering "how to optimize the survivor mode" after fixing the bugs found recently. For example: change to automatic attack, etc.

The above~
I hope you like our game~
Thank you again for your support~
ღ( ´･ᴗ･` )

notes.notes:
The demo version is now on STEAM!
You are welcome to try it out for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206200/_/

New Festival Demo Version Description:

[b]New Character: Shield Swordsman Karin[/b]
New Drama Color Shield Swordsman Karin now joins the battle. Karin is an offensive and defensive warrior, and players can now switch and try out the character in camp!

[b]Talent System[/b]
The Talent System is now available, and players can upgrade their Talents through the Tree Leaves to increase their strength!

[b]Survivor Mode and Artifact System[/b]
The new Survivor Mode is now open. In this mode, endless enemies come like a tidal wave, testing your combat skills and strategic planning.

[b]Improve the guidance system[/b]
For this update, we have remade the game guide. The old guidance was vague and confused many new players when they first entered the game.

We believe that the new guidance system will provide a smoother and more comfortable start to the game for both new and old players, allowing everyone to immerse themselves in the game world and enjoy the game to the fullest!

If you find any bugs or negative experiences in the game, please leave us a message and we will fix the problem as soon as possible!

PS: Wishlist number is very important for indie games on steam! If you like our game, please add it for us. It's really, really important to us. Thank you all!
